request.spec:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The consolidated figures now show, for grades A, B and C, the due-totals of the people on that grade added up over the whole tree (retired people left out). For each of the six claim statuses they show the number of claims in that status over the tree. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**Server** (`rollup/Rollup.java`, `rollup/ConsolidatedController.java`): for each sheet, a person counts under the grade they hold on that sheet's today; a due-total of n/a adds nothing. A person counts as retired as soon as a retirement date is set, which is the same rule the summary panel already uses. The descendants endpoint returns these figures for the descendant sheets and, separately, for the sheet itself. When the screen views the sheet as of a date, every sheet is taken as it stood at the end of that date. No database change was needed.

**Front end** (`core/session.ts`, `features/header/header.ts`): the header shows the new values with the test ids `consolidated-grade-<A|B|C>-due-total` and `consolidated-status-<DRAFT|OPEN|PENDING|SETTLED|VOID|REVIEW>-count`. It works like the existing consolidated figures: the current sheet's share comes from the live figures on screen and the descendants' share from the server. When viewing as of a date, both come from the server.

As with the existing consolidated figures, the descendants' part is fetched when the sheet is loaded. A change made on another sheet in the tree only shows after re-loading the sheet.
